scene: 家里一架古钢琴 · 被来访客人用力弹爵士乐弄断了弦 · 现在不许碰、正由父亲的朋友修理

grammar_card.title: 说"某物被…"(被动语态)
grammar_card.intro: 本课讲怎么说"某物被别人怎么样了"——被动语态。主角是动作的承受者。全用本课句子举例。

rows: 被动语态 = be + 过去分词(主角是'被…的那一方')
It was made in Germany.(古钢琴被造)
一般现在被动:am / is / are + 过去分词
The clavichord is kept in the living room.
一般过去被动:was / were + 过去分词
Two of the strings were broken.
要指出'谁做的',用 by + 动作执行者
It was bought by my grandpa.
主动变被动:原来的宾语挪到前面当主角,动词变 be + 过去分词
Workmen built the road. → The road was built by workmen.

specialRules.rule: 被动语态的时态靠改变 be 来体现,过去分词永远不变
否定:be + not + 过去分词(are not allowed);疑问:把 be 提前(Was it made…?)

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — What happened to the clavichord?
options: It was damaged by a visitor

passage: My family owns an old musical instrument called a clavichord. It was made in Germany over three hundred years ago. The clavichord is kept in our living room. It has belonged to my family for generations. It was bought by my grandpa a long time ago. Recently, it was damaged by a visitor. She wanted to practice jazz on it and struck the keys too hard. Two of the strings were broken, and my dad was shocked. Now none of us are allowed to touch it. It is being repaired by a friend of my dad's. Soon we will be able to play it again.
